passive_abilities.name: Veteran Adventurer
passive_abilities.description: In the Ready step of each Strategy phase after the first, if this operative is in the killzone and isn’t within control range of enemy operatives, you gain 1 Resourceful point.

passive_abilities.name: Outright Conviction
passive_abilities.description: The first time this operative would be incapacitated during the battle, it’s not incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining and cannot be incapacitated for the remainder of the action. All remaining attack dice are discarded (including yours if this operative is fighting or retaliating).

passive_abilities.name: Stalker
passive_abilities.description: This operative can perform the Charge action while it has a Conceal order.

passive_abilities.name: Irrepressible Hardiness
passive_abilities.description: If this operative is incapacitated during the Fight action, you can strike the enemy operative in that sequence with one of your unresolved successes before this operative is removed from the killzone.

passive_abilities.name: Wroughtlock Negotiation
passive_abilities.description: STRATEGIC GAMBIT. This operative can immediately perform a free Shoot action (you can change its order to Engage to do so).

passive_abilities.name: Brazen Killer
passive_abilities.description: Whenever this operative incapacitates an enemy operative with its wroughtlock revolvers, roll one D6 separately for each other enemy operative visible to and within 2" of that enemy operative: if the result is higher than that other enemy operative’s APL stat, subtract 1 from its APL stat until the end of its next activation.

passive_abilities.name: *Bipod
passive_abilities.description: Whenever this operative is shooting with this weapon, if it hasn’t moved during the activation, or if it’s a counteraction, this weapon has the Ceaseless weapon rule. Note this operative isn’t restricted from moving after shooting.

passive_abilities.name: Minefield
passive_abilities.description: You have five Minefield markers for the battle. On the reverse side, three of them are HY-Pex mines (see below) and two are blank. Set up all your Minefield markers as if they were one item of equipment. Each must be set up reverse-side down (their specifics aren’t revealed), more than 2" from other markers, access points and Accessible terrain, and more than 6" from your opponent’s drop zone and your other Minefield markers. Whenever this operative is readied, if it’s not within control range of enemy operatives, you can reset one of your flipped Minefield markers that’s within its control range (flip the marker back over again).

passive_abilities.name: HY-Pex Mines
passive_abilities.description: Whenever one of your reverse-side down Minefield markers is both within an enemy operative’s control range and not within a friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR operative’s control range, flip the marker over. If it’s a blank, there’s no effect. If it’s a HY-Pex mine, inflict 3 damage on that enemy operative and roll one D6: if the result is less than that enemy operative’s Save stat, inflict additional damage on it equal to the dice result; regardless of the result, if it isn’t incapacitated, end its action (if any), even if that action’s effects aren’t fulfilled. If it cannot be placed, move it the minimum amount to do so. Regardless, that marker isn’t removed.

weapons.name: Magna-coil rifle (concealed)
weapons.special_rules: Devastating 3, Heavy, Piercing 1, Silent, Concealed Position*

passive_abilities.name: *Concealed Position
passive_abilities.description: This operative can only use this weapon the first time it’s performing the Shoot action during the battle.

passive_abilities.name: Weavewërke Cloak
passive_abilities.description: Whenever an operative is shooting this operative: •  Ignore the Saturate weapon rule. •  If you can retain any cover saves, you can retain one additional cover save, or you can retain one cover save as a critical success instead. This isn’t cumulative with improved cover saves from Vantage terrain.

passive_abilities.name: Pan Spectral Visor
passive_abilities.description: Whenever this operative is shooting an operative within 6" of it: •  This operative’s weapons have the Seek Light weapon rule. •  That operative cannot be obscured.

passive_abilities.name: Tracker
passive_abilities.description: Whenever this operative is shooting against or fighting against an expended operative within 6" of it, this operative’s weapons have the Punishing weapon rule.

passive_abilities.name: Intrepid
passive_abilities.description: Whenever you spend a Resourceful point for this operative, the following take precedence: •  If you add 1 to its APL stat, it lasts until the start of its next activation instead. •  If it regains lost wounds, it regains up to 4 instead.
